Here’s a quick note you can copy into your phone’s notes app, calendar, or any reminder tool you use: --- **Reminder – March 27, 2024** 📅 **Date:** 27 March 2024 ⏰ **Time:** (pick a time that works best for you) 💬 **Task:** Check and renew your Netflix subscription. 🔔 **Notes:** - Verify the billing cycle and payment method. - Consider any available promotions or family plan options. - Set a calendar event or alarm so you don’t miss it. --- **How to set it up:** | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **iPhone / iPad** | 1. Open the **Calendar** app.
2. Tap “+” → “Event”.
3. Enter the title “Renew Netflix Subscription”.
4. Set the date to March 27, 2024.
5. Add an alert (e.g., 1 day before). | | **Android** | 1. Open the **Google Calendar** app.
2. Tap “+” → “Create event”.
3. Fill in the details and set a notification. | | **Windows** | 1. Open **Outlook** or **Calendar**.
2. Create a new event on March 27, 2024.
3. Add a reminder. | | **Mac** | 1. Open **Calendar**.
2. Click “+” → “New Event”.
3. Set the date and add an alert. | If you prefer a simple text reminder, just paste the note above into your notes app and set a reminder for March 27. Let me know if you’d like help setting it up on a specific device!
